title: Ask this report
description: Explore a report in separate topics. Each topic uses only the evidence saved for its report version.
noReport: Questions become available when a report version has been published.
legacy: This older report uses a reconstructed snapshot of its associated evidence. Historical evidence states may not be recoverable.
empty: Ask about a finding, compare the supporting evidence, or explore a gap. Your conversation stays with this report version.
question: You
thinking: Preparing an answer from saved evidence…
hint: No new searches. Earlier replies are conversation context, not evidence.
deleteDescription: Delete this topic and its saved questions and answers? The report will remain available.

errors.SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE: The report is saved and can be read or exported. Its evidence snapshot is unavailable, so questions about this version are disabled.
errors.REPORT_UNAVAILABLE: The saved report is unavailable. Open another version or restore its stored artifact.
errors.THREAD_UNAVAILABLE: This topic is no longer available.
errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Saved research storage is unavailable. Your existing reports have not been changed.
errors.EXCLUSIVE_UNAVAILABLE: This browser cannot safely coordinate answers across tabs. Use a browser with Web Locks support.
errors.ANSWER_BUSY: This topic is already answering in another tab.
errors.INVALID_QUESTION: Enter a question of up to 8,000 characters.
errors.INVALID_RETRY: Only the latest unsuccessful answer can be retried.
errors.INVALID_CITATION: The answer referenced a source outside this report’s saved evidence. Retry to request a grounded answer.
errors.EMPTY_ANSWER: The model returned an empty answer. Please retry.
errors.GENERATION_FAILED: The answer could not be completed. Check the model connection or saved storage and retry.
